campaigns.note: Primary campaign: port sweep, .exe/.ps1 payloads, 4444 reverse shell. All Windows/PowerShell endpoint events merge into this pair, supplying exploitation and persistence.
SSH scan, loader.exe over 8080, Meterpreter C2 on 5555. No endpoint telemetry, so no exploitation or persistence is expected.

Nmap scan, ransom.bat delivery, then outbound to high port 8888. C2 is expected because auto-detect promotes 8888 to a C2 port (>1024, uncommon, attacker to victim) — this campaign exercises the auto-detected C2 path rather than a preconfigured port.
Second attacker against the primary victim. Low alert volume, so it is NOT in the auto-detected top-3 attacker list — tests that classification still fires on the .exe URL rule for unknown hosts.
Third-party pair involving neither the detected attacker nor victim. Verifies the engine correlates unknown hosts on signature rules alone.
